derivation: from the base of G4556 (σάρδιος) and (the nail of a finger;
def: hence the "onyx" stone); a "sardonyx", i.e. the gem so called

occurrences.text: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.
